reason: £300 is a lot on my money and I'd be handing it to a brand new seller with no reviews and no history. I can get used sets cheaper on Marketplace and eBay where I can at least see the seller's feedback.
objection: New seller, no reviews. If the wheels turn out bent or the repair is dodgy after I've paid cash, I've got nothing to go on and a 7-day return only works if I don't mark them.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews or photos of finished sets from other local customers, a few months on the platform, and a price nearer £200-£220 a set.
